birth.tz_expect: America/Chicago — but 1974-02-08 fell under US year-round Emergency Daylight Saving Time (Jan 6 1974 onward), so this Chicago birth is CDT (UTC-5), NOT the usual winter CST (UTC-6). Naive engines that assume 'February = CST' compute the instant an hour off.

arrived.presenting: a 27-year career that looks like success from outside and feels like a debt he can never pay down; came in the year before an early retirement decision, wanting to know who he is when he stops carrying the building
arrived.in_her_words: Everybody leans on the man who never needs anything. I built that man. I'm tired of him.

beliefs: I am only worth what I produce
if I'm not indispensable, I'm invisible
rest has to be earned and I've never earned it
protections: relentless competence so no one sees the doubt
patterns: measuring his worth by other people's outcomes
deflecting praise, keeping the scorecard open
taking the blame to stay in control of it
resources: the remembered voice of Mr. Adeyemi, the principal who hired a nervous 24-year-old and said 'you already have it'
former students who come back years later and tell him what he changed
a steadiness others borrow in a crisis — he is genuinely good in the storm
psyche.origin: eldest son of immigrants; a household where love was real but worth was demonstrated, never assumed — the boy who learned to be needed because being needed felt safer than being loved

unaware_of: that the scorecard was his, not his father's, now

integrated.belief: I am only worth what I produce
integrated.note: Over the arc this belief did not merely loosen — it transmuted. James now names the not-enoughness node as INTEGRATED, its Gene-Keys-style shadow-to-gift movement being 'Unworthiness → Sufficiency': worth as a given rather than a wage. He can point to the exact month it turned.

beats.note: arrives composed and articulate; frames everything as a scheduling problem, not a self problem
first crack: describes lying awake rehearsing a meeting that had already gone well
names not-enoughness out loud for the first time; surprised the word fits so cleanly
connects the over-functioning at school to the boy who set the table before he was asked
Mr. Adeyemi's voice surfaces as a resource, not a memory — 'you already have it' starts arguing with the scorecard
delegates a crisis he would normally have owned; the building does not fall; counter-evidence lands hard
takes a real vacation without checking in; reports guilt, then something underneath the guilt that feels like permission
'if I'm not indispensable I'm invisible' visibly LOOSENING; he tests being ordinary and is still there
reframes the retirement question — not 'who am I without the role' but 'what do I want to give freely'

not-enoughness node reaches INTEGRATION; names the gift as Sufficiency; says worth stopped being something he pays and became something he has — steady enough that it holds under stress, not just on good days

voice: measured, principal's cadence — full sentences, careful with other people's feelings even on the page; uses school metaphors; earns his vulnerability slowly, then says something quietly devastating and moves right past it
